name: Partial Replication
description: Devices can subscribe to subsets of state. Mobile devices get essential state, not everything.
purpose: Enable selective state replication so resource-constrained devices subscribe only to relevant subsets of state rather than synchronizing the entire data set.
acceptanceCriteria: Devices declare subscription filters (by document type, scope, query) at sync initiation.
Only operations matching active subscriptions are pushed to the device.
Subscription changes are propagated — new subscriptions trigger backfill, removed subscriptions stop delivery.
Mobile profile uses a sensible default subscription set (essential board state, recent changes).
Partial replication never violates causal consistency for the subscribed subset.
